name: BCM Subscription Manager for WooCommerce
author: miklospower

sections.description:
Plan ahead once. Stay flexible anytime.

BCM KitchenSync transforms how WooCommerce subscriptions work by giving customers full control over their future orders while reducing admin for your business.

Most subscription systems rely on customers remembering weekly cut-off times and contacting your team to make changes. BCM KitchenSync removes that friction by enabling forward planning and self-management.

Customers can organise their subscriptions weeks in advance, then adjust anytime when life changes — without needing support.

Perfect for businesses that depend on recurring orders and flexible delivery schedules.

Why BCM KitchenSync?

Subscriptions shouldn’t create stress.

Customers forget cut-off times. Plans change. Businesses end up handling manual updates, support requests, and operational complexity.

BCM KitchenSync solves this by allowing customers to:
– Plan ahead
– Stay flexible
– Manage everything themselves

Result:
– Fewer support requests
– Fewer missed changes
– Smoother operations
– Better customer experience

Features

1–52 Week Forward Planning

Customers can plan and manage subscriptions anywhere from 1 to 52 weeks ahead.
– Reduce forgotten cut-offs
– Improve order visibility
– Enable better fulfilment planning

Full Customer Self-Management

Customers can:
– Edit individual weeks
– Pause specific deliveries
– Cancel or restart subscriptions
– Manage their entire plan without support

Pause Individual Weeks

Customers can skip specific weeks without cancelling their full subscription.
Ideal for holidays or schedule changes.

Powerful Admin Controls

Gain deeper control over subscriptions with flexible management tools.

How It Works

  1. Customers choose a subscription
  2. They plan future weeks (1–52 weeks ahead)
  3. They update anytime if plans change
  4. Your operations run smoothly with less manual work

Ideal For

  • Meal kit companies
  • Subscription product brands
  • Recurring delivery services
  • WooCommerce stores needing flexible subscriptions

Business Benefits

BCM KitchenSync helps you:
– Reduce manual admin
– Improve customer experience
– Minimise missed cut-off issues
– Streamline recurring workflows
– Build more predictable revenue

Comparison

Standard WooCommerce subscription plugins focus on recurring billing.

BCM KitchenSync goes further by enabling customer-led planning.

Key differences:
– Customers can plan future weeks (1–52 weeks)
– Customers avoid weekly cut-off stress
– Edit individual deliveries easily
– Pause specific weeks without cancelling
– Built-in upsells and advanced promotions
– More powerful admin controls and analytics

External services

This plugin connects to the Stripe API to process payments and manage subscriptions.

When a customer makes a purchase, the plugin sends payment-related information to Stripe, which may include the customer’s name, email address, billing details, payment method information, transaction amount, and IP address. This information is required to securely process payments and prevent fraud.

Stripe Privacy Policy:
https://stripe.com/privacy

Stripe Terms of Service:
https://stripe.com/legal

Support

For support, please contact: team@blackchalkmarketing.com.au
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/bcm-subscription-manager-stripe directory, or install via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Configure settings via WooCommerce settings panel.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Can customers manage their own subscriptions?

Yes. Customers can edit, pause, and manage future orders themselves.

How far ahead can customers plan?

Up to 52 weeks in advance.

Can customers skip specific weeks?

Yes. Individual weeks can be paused without cancelling the full subscription.
